bio: It is well worth venturing into this discreet and exclusive fine dining table d'hôte concealed by a secret door behind the bar. A handpicked group of 15 or so guests are welcomed by the owner himself, who is then on hand throughout the meal to ensure that everything runs smoothly. The kitchen sends out elegant and carefully crafted classic dishes based on excellent regional ingredients – some with subtle Mediterranean touches. An intimate and hospitable atmosphere reigns here, with the same relaxed style as in the lively, bustling bar. You'll need to book well in advance....
